subject: Request: SLA waiver & commission floor for Greenline private listing
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Greenline Analytics <ops@greenline.com>, procurement@greenline.com
Cc: markus_klein@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Private offer proposal + rev-share ask (Greenline Analytics)

Hi Team —

Thanks again for the demo today. Greenline is a great fit for our AWS private listing. Per our conversation, attached is a draft private offer (PDF) and a short mutual action plan. High level:

- Offer: 12 month commitment, $240k ARR (annualized)
- Pricing requested by customer: 30% off list for compute/ingress; want marketplace rev-share floor set to 6% (below standard 10%)
- SLA ask: 99.6% uptime SLO with credits structured as a waiver (customer wants reduced penalty exposure)

Amiya (AWS) is looped in on the logistics. Greenline's Procurement asked we escalate to leadership for any commission-floor and SLA deviations — they indicated timeline sensitivity and want to surface this week.

Next steps: can you confirm if we can approve the 6% rev-share floor and the proposed SLA carveout (or recommend allowable alternatives)? I’ve attached the MAP and the initial private offer PDF.

Thanks —

Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
Attachments: Private_Offer_Draft.pdf, Greenline_Mutual_Action_Plan.xlsx
From: Procurement <procurement@greenline.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: markus_klein@redwood.com, aws-amiya@amazon.com
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Private offer proposal + rev-share ask (Greenline Analytics)

Marissa —

Thanks for the materials. A couple clarifying Qs before we proceed:

1) The customer needs a firm marketplace rev-share floor at 6% (we will list at that rate). Is Redwood able to accept a lower commission for this account?
2) Regarding SLA: can Redwood provide a contractual carveout so that credits are limited to a single monthly credit (customer prefers this to avoid revenue volatility)?
3) We will need a redline-ready private offer (DocuSign) by Friday to keep our board timeline.

If you need a formal business justification for exceptions, please send to procurement@greenline.com and cc ops@greenline.com.

Regards,
J. Patel
Manager, Procurement
Greenline Analytics
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, rafael_mendes@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 12:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Private offer proposal + rev-share ask (Greenline Analytics) — Exec approval request

Team — forwarding the Greenline thread. We need an expedited decision on two non-standard asks: 1) lower marketplace rev-share floor to 6% for this private listing; 2) SLA credit cap/waiver structure (single monthly credit cap vs. standard cumulative credits).

Why I recommend we consider this:
- Deal economics: ~$240k ARR; expected to expand to >$800k ARR over 18 months (finance model attached in the MAP).
- Strategic value: Greenline is an analytics platform with strong AWS marketplace visibility; landing them would help our AWS co-sell and add a reference case in healthcare analytics.
- Risk: reduced rev-share will decrease partner channel revenue but keeps the net revenue at scale (see attachment). SLA waiver increases operational exposure; we should limit to a time-bound pilot (first 6 months) with defined monitoring and a rollback clause if SLOs degrade.

Requested approvals / ask:
1) Approve 6% rev-share floor for Greenline private offer (one-off, non-precedential).
2) Approve SLA credit cap: single monthly credit equal to one month’s invoice, pilot period of 6 months.
3) Approve legal to send DocuSign-ready private offer with those carveouts.

Attachments: Private_Offer_Draft.pdf, SLA_Deviation_Form.docx, Greenline_Mutual_Action_Plan.xlsx

Please reply with Approve / Decline / Approve with changes. Time-sensitive: procurement needs redline by Friday EOD.

- Markus
VP, North America Sales
Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.com
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, markus_klein@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, rafael_mendes@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 15:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Private offer proposal + rev-share ask (Greenline) — Deal desk analysis

Lauren / Markus —

Quick deal desk read:
- Revenue impact: At 6% rev-share vs standard 10% on $240k ARR, incremental channel reduction is ~$9,600 ARR (first year). Upside if expansion to $800k ARR scales similarly.
- Margin: With quantization/commit optimizations, expected cost-of-serving stays within target.
- Precedent risk: low if we tie to single-account, single-listing and document non-precedential status in HubSpot/Deal Desk notes.

Risk mitigations I recommend:
- Conditional approval: 6% rev-share for initial 12-month listing but subject to a 6-month performance review. If growth < 30% QoQ, revert to 10% or terminate listing.
- SLA: approve single monthly credit cap for first 6 months only. Require automated SLO monitoring and weekly reporting to CS/Platform.
- Finance asks for a delegated approval limit sign-off from Lauren due to the commission deviation exceeding my delegation.

If Lauren signs off we will: 1) Instruct Legal to produce DocuSign-ready private offer; 2) update HubSpot with the exception and the review dates; 3) notify AWS account team for marketplace listing enablement.

Karthik Iyer
Sr. Manager, Deal Desk
Redwood Inference
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, rafael_mendes@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 09:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Private offer proposal + rev-share ask (Greenline) — Exec approval request

Markus / Karthik —

Approved, with constraints:

1) Rev-share floor: Approve 6% for Greenline Analytics, one-off and explicitly non-precedential. Documentation required: HubSpot exception ticket + entry in the Deal Desk exceptions registry (Karthik, please create).
2) SLA credit cap: Approve single-month credit cap for the first 6 months only. Require an automated SLO dashboard and weekly ops updates. If any severity > 1 incident occurs, the cap is voided and standard crediting applies.
3) Performance trigger: If Greenline does not hit the 30% QoQ growth threshold by month 6, Deal Desk will revert the rev-share to 10% or pull the private listing.
4) Legal: prepare DocuSign private offer and include the SLA_Deviation_Form.docx language verbatim. Use one-off exception clause language and copy me on final.

Karthik: please produce the HubSpot exception ID and the DocuSign link by EOD so Marissa can keep Procurement on schedule.

Approved — Lauren Bishop
VP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
